name: f4-curv-depth-kpi-latent-space-graph
description: Read-only HTML dashboard for the F4_CURV_DEPTH_KPI_LATENT_SPACE (F4-alternative) skill: renders the real GDX_HNF_CDIH_* rows (CDIh distribution histogram, per-latent-dimension RMS contribution ranking, and representative per-person difference profiles) as a standalone page, over the Firebird wire protocol (no native client library needed).
